result_text:
`all_files.zip` is now built from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer drops it or `git-history.zip`. The `reports` module compiles. I did not run any tests or try a renamed config end to end.

The change is in `DataExporter.exportJson`, in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. The five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals are gone. The method now collects the main, test, generated, build-and-deployment and other aspects in that order. For each one it gets the file name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same helper that writes the loose text files. It then reads that file and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With the default config the entries and their order are unchanged. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`.
